# Sanskarut Tech Team

> Sanskarut Tech Team is a software engineering and digital solutions company specializing in website development, SaaS platforms, web applications, AI integrations, automation systems, and custom software solutions.

## Company Information

* Company: Sanskarut Tech Team
* Website: https://sanskarut.qzz.io
* Support Email: [support@sanskarut.qzz.io](mailto:support@sanskarut.qzz.io)
* Founder: Sanskar Bandgar
* Headquarters: Maharashtra, India

## Services

* Custom Website Development
* SaaS Platform Development
* Web Application Development
* E-Commerce Solutions
* AI Integration & Automation
* Technical SEO Optimization
* API Development & Integration
* Student & Startup Technology Solutions

## Technology Stack

* Next.js
* React
* TypeScript
* Node.js
* Tailwind CSS
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* REST APIs
* Cloud Infrastructure
